chapter_length.notes: New or substantively updated chapters entering future release inventory must contain at least 2001 non-whitespace正文 characters. Existing historical chapters are not retroactively blocked by this publishing gate unless they are being updated.

daily_word_floor.notes: Every normal release day is exactly three consecutive chapters at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai and must contain strictly more than 6000 non-whitespace正文 characters. Partial release days and auto-continue scheduling are forbidden.

notes: Hard release invariant: each normal day publishes exactly three consecutive audited chapters at 00:00 Asia/Shanghai with a daily正文 total strictly greater than 6000. Future creates must use an explicit fixed start date. A fresh read-only reconcile is required before any strict reschedule so the expected pending chapter set is recorded and auditable.
